_comment: Canonical zkRoute deployment record for Arc testnet (Canteen). Update this file after every deploy. All other docs link here so addresses live in exactly one place.

network.name: Arc Testnet (Canteen)
network._note: The Canteen-issued RPC URL embeds a per-user auth token (`swrm_...`). Do NOT commit that URL — keep it in your local `.env`. This file records only the public chain ID.

USDC._status: MockERC20 — deployed because no canonical Arc USDC address was supplied. Replace with the real Circle USDC once you have it.

CommitReveal._status: Has 100 revealed signals from earlier work; reused by the winCount SignalMarket.

Verifier._status: Real Groth16Verifier for the winCount circuit (build/track_record_final.zkey v2). Wired into SignalMarket constructor.

SignalMarket._status: winCount circuit, CommitReveal 0x257beDCe… (100 reveals), Groth16Verifier 0x1751D8d0… wired via constructor. Closes blockers #3 + #4.

owner._note: Owner is the deployer EOA. Transfer to a multisig before any mainnet promotion.

circle._note: Circle account creds (CIRCLE_API_KEY, CIRCLE_ENTITY_SECRET) live only in .env — never commit them.
